meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: Claude 会按任务挑出「指挥、执行、评审」三类角色智能体组成团队,用串行、并行、循环等流程协作,并展示讨论、辩论与决策过程,最后汇总成统一结果。
howto.when: 当复杂任务需要多个智能体协同完成,或你需要为特定场景组建智能体组合时触发;例如产品经理、项目管理类工作。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估是否采用微服务架构
say.note: 各角色发言、辩论后汇总出会议记录与结论

say.text: 请用 OPC 团队构建 AI 短视频领域的系统
say.note: 按战略、产品架构、自动化工程三步推进并交付方案

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场、财务、评审角色讨论后给出定价结论

howto.what_en: Claude assembles an AI team of director, executor and reviewer roles, runs them in serial, parallel or looped workflows, shows the debate, and merges their outputs into one result.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a complex task needs several agents working together, or when you want a scenario-specific mix of agent roles, such as product or project management work.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to review whether we should adopt microservices
say_en.note: Roles speak, debate, then a meeting record and conclusion are merged

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short videos
say_en.note: Runs strategy, product architecture then automation engineering steps

say_en.text: Use the product team to set a pricing strategy for this product
say_en.note: Market, finance and review roles discuss, then give a conclusion
